messages:
Evan (AE): Heads up—Prospect Pori's POC streaming demo dropped mid-response twice. They called it a blocker for contract sign.

Lina (solutions): sorry to hear. which browser/network? any proxy in path?

Evan (AE): Chrome on managed Windows. Traffic goes through their corporate proxy (PoriProxy). Using hosted API model=redwood-chat-small stream=true.

Marco (eng): assigning. quick suspicion: corporate proxy cutting idle SSE -> truncated chunk -> client JSON.parse fails. Also check for token rotation 401s.

Tess (platform): infra shows upstream 502s and FIN from PoriProxy around 2001230034 for that session. No system-wide 429 spikes. Auth logs show a token refresh attempt at 2001230032 that returned a transient 401.

Lina (solutions): client console snippet from prospect: 
```
EventSource open
onmessage: data len=180
onmessage: data len=34 -> Uncaught SyntaxError: Unexpected end of JSON input
reconnect in 1.5s
fetch error: net::ERR_CONNECTION_RESET
```

Marco (eng): suggests we ask PoriProxy admin to: 1) increase idle timeout to >=60s, 2) disable buffering/compression for `Accept: text/event-stream`, and 3) forward keep-alive. If nginx, set `X-Accel-Buffering: no`.

Tess (platform): short-server mitigation we can roll: SSE comment heartbeat every 10s, `retry:2000`, `Cache-Control: no-transform`, and allow a small auth-race window so a token refresh doesn't abort an in-flight stream. I'll queue a small canary. deploy-bot: schedule canary for sse-heartbeat toggle.

deploy-bot: Canary queued: sse-heartbeat=10s (canary size: 3 hosts).

Lina (solutions): customer also asked if Dedicated would help. Answer: yes, Dedicated in their VPC would remove corporate proxy from path and likely avoid this class of truncation.

Evan (AE): I'll ask prospect to bump proxy timeout and try bypass test. Also send them the SDK snippet to buffer partial chunks until full JSON received.

Marco (eng): created ticket INF-1357 for SDK graceful reassembly + auth refresh resilience.

Tess (platform): monitoring shows no repeats after canary queued (last related event 2001230098).

Evan (AE): thanks all—I'll update customer and keep thread open until they confirm. :thumbsup:
